verses.gurmukhi: ਦੋਹਰਾ: ਅਸਚਰਜਹਿ ਅਸਚਰਜ ਗਤਿ ਬਿਸਮਾਦਹਿ ਬਿਸਮਾਦ ॥ ਅਦਭੁਤ ਪਰਮਦਭੁਤ ਭਏ ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਪਰਮਾਦਿ ॥
verses.translit_en: dhoharaa: asacharajeh asacharaj gat bisamaadheh bisamaadh || adhabhut paramadhabhut bhe aadh purakh paramaadh ||

en.bdb: Dohra: (Describing the essence of the Guru), we have reached the high stage of magnificence and ecstaticisim. I have reached this stage of transcendence by seeing the magnificence of the Lord, who is the beginning of the cosmos and beyond.
